lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular clusters arranged in distinct vertical columns posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Pronounced vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting with circular blobs to create a rectangular grid-like pattern on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Linear horizontal features along the upper flank displaying a sharp vertical gradient from high luminance above to shadow below.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal organisms (Echeneidae) trailing the posterior edge of the pectoral fin and ventral silhouette.
